responsibility: Implements the RTL Swing Modulo Scheduling (SMS) pass for software pipelining eligible loops. It builds and manipulates partial schedules over loop DDGs, computes and tests initiation intervals against dependence and DFA resource constraints, orders and places loop instructions within modulo-scheduled rows, and supports the kernel/prologue/epilogue style transformation required for pipelined execution, including register-move and stage-count handling. This file owns the modulo scheduler proper and its RTL pass entry point, distinct from generic loop unrolling or doloop conversion.
